Source.Name: ghostty
Source.Summary: Fast, native, feature-rich terminal emulator pushing modern features
Source.Description: Ghostty is a terminal emulator that differentiates itself by being fast, feature-rich, and native. While there are many excellent terminal emulators available, they all force you to choose between speed, features, or native UIs. Ghostty provides all three.
